title: A Salt for the Thorn Anew
author: Edmund Montrose
blurb: Elodie Ravensworth, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
